semantic_fragments.content: Working Voltage / Power Measurement at clause 8.4.2: Between opposite polarity of batteries, Vdc = 3V. Input supply voltage to ME EQUIPMENT was the RATED voltage or the voltage within the RATED voltage range which results in the highest measured value (see clause 8.5.4). If the d.c peak-to-peak ripple >10%, waveform is considered as a.c. (see clause 8.4.2.2).

Clause 8.4.3: ME EQUIPMENT for connection to a power source by a plug - measurement of voltage or calculation of stored charge 1 second after disconnection of plug from mains supply. Maximum allowable stored charge when measured voltage exceeded 60V: 45 μC. All measured voltage values are N/A (--) indicating this test is not applicable to this device.

Clause 7.9.3.2 RM RESULTS TABLE: Replacement of fuses, power supply cords, other parts is marked N/A, with all ISO 14971 sub-clauses (5.2, 5.3, 5.4, 6, 7.2, 7.3, 7.4, 7.5) having no document references or results recorded.
